rules.name: Dive Bomb
rules.description: Once a round, at the end of any turn, a single steeplewrack unit may MOVE for free.

rules.name: Rip Apart (X)
rules.description: This ability gains extra bonuses if X or more allied units or walls are adjacent to the target, including this unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Do not deploy the owl normally. instead, it arrives at the start of round 3 but may be deployed in any free space. When it lands, it may destroy any walls under its space before being placed.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: For the rest of combat, all allied units double their MV stat, Dive Bomb can be used twice per round instead of just once, and units may deal 1 damage to an adjacent unit when they Dive Bomb.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: For every unit slot spent on Flock, you may summon an additional flock unit in a free space adjacent to an allied unit at the end of every odd round.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: 2 of these units are worth 1 unit slot. Can be activated two at a time.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This unit gains 1 or (6+) 2 *speed*. It may then immediately spend two speed tokens to summon an additional Flock unit in a free adjacent space.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This faction’s *dive bomb* trait can be used for free on one Flock unit a round.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Bloodletting gains *Rip Apart (5+)*: and deal 1 curse damage again.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At round 5+, become immune to graze, line, and splash damage.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: May spend a *speed* token when attacked by an ACT ability to give the attacker -1D on the attack roll and step 1 after the ability resolves.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: 1 damage. *Rip Apart* (2+): +1 damage and gain 1 *speed*, Rip Apart (4+): and gain 1 *strength* and summon a Flock adjacent to the target.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Create a wall in range, then grant 1 *speed* to one (3+) or two, (5+) or all allied units next to the wall.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Slay an adjacent allied unit. This unit may ACT again and gains 1 *speed* (4+) and 1 *strength*. Can only be used once a turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Raise Roost gains +1 range and when it creates a wall, it may first pull a unit in range 2 one space.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At 1 hp or lower, this unit is immune to damage from grazes, lines, and splash effects.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Cannibalize can also be used on an enemy unit at 1 hp or lower, but does not grant tokens if used this way.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: May move through walls, but not end its turn in one. When moving through a wall, gain *free movement* until end of turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Step 2 with *free movement*, then create a wall in a free adjacent space. May then slay an adjacent allied unit to regain ACT. Can only be used once a turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: 1 damage. *Rip Apart (2+)*: with *pierce*, *Rip Apart (4+)*: then 1 damage again, and summon a Flock unit adjacent to target.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While adjacent to a wall, is *curseproof*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If starting turn adjacent to a wall, gain 1 *speed* and clear a negative token.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While target is adjacent to a wall, damage always gains *pierce* and ignores *vitality*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Ignores adverse terrain, and elevation attack and movement penalties.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Target enemy unit always counts as having +2 of your units adjacent to it, even when alone. This effect lasts until this ability is used again or the Siren is slain.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: *Splash (self)*: 1 curse damage to foes. Push all units one (4+) or two spaces.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the start of this unit’s next turn, adjacent enemy units take -1D on attacks, and self and adjacent allies are immune to graze damage.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When Siren’s Song expires, up to three adjacent allies gain 1 *speed*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Sonic screech may slay an ally in the area to regain ACT, but can only be used once a turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Paranoia deals 1 *piercing* curse damage, but only counts as +1 adjacent unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This unit also counts as wall. It blocks line of sight and can be used for cover like a wall. Effects that would destroy walls have no effect on this unit.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Gain 1 *speed*. Until end of this unit’s next turn, after any adjacent unit is slain, summon a flock in free space in range 1-2. This effect cannot trigger more than once a turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Gain Physical Armor. Any unit that starts or ends a MOVE in an adjacent space takes 1 damage. This effect cannot trigger more than once a turn, and lasts indefinitely or until this unit MOVEs or steps.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Flense ignores armor and *vitality* if its target has 1 hp or lower.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If feeding call triggers two or more times before it expires, this unit gains 2 *strength*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Horrendous Pecking does not break if this unit moves out of its turn.
